target: Xbox 360 New Xbox Experience dashboard (2008-2010), a channel with its tiles, 1920x1080
sources: YouTube, SlasherExtras, "NXE Dashboard [XBOX 360]", https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=LeLocNfgexM (1080p, an OBS capture): the My Xbox channel at 262-286 s, a carousel step at 286.10-286.47 s; frames read in the browser at 1/30 s steps, nothing downloaded
Layout, timing and colours only: no tiles, icons, avatars, sounds, fonts or names from the target are used

measurements.tiles behind: to the right and smaller, a little higher: the second 470 x 355 ending x 1239 (y 424-779), the third 372 x 282 ending x 1516 (y 454-736); in a perspective model that's a 1200 px perspective, 411 px depth per step, 734 px (116.5% of a tile) apart, the projection centre ~47 px above the front tile's middle, no tilt
measurements.titles: the current channel's title over the front tile at x 149, centred on y ~302 (~52 px type, white), the channels above stacked upward, smaller and fainter at y 237, 188, 146
measurements.count and hints: '1 of 8' under the front tile at x 143, y 883; the select hint at x 152, y 973; the gamer tag top right ending x 1660, centred on y 120
measurements.motion: a carousel step takes ~370 ms, fast at first
measurements.colours: deep green sky (#4f7f11) brightening to #cce18a, a grey floor (#a1a8b6 to #6e6f76), lime tiles (#c4e431), white type

actions.eval: document.getElementById('icefin-theme-root').orbitFill([0, 1, 2].map(c => ({title: 'channel ' + c, tiles: Array.from({length: 6}, (_, i) => ({label: 'Tile ' + c + '.' + i, sub: '', art: '', go: () => {}}))})))
